title: TLS certificate verification disabled when z/VM connector URL lacks CA file
detail: ConnectorClient.__init__() sets verify=False on the ZVMConnector when either (a) the configured URL scheme is not https or (b) the https URL is configured but no ca_file is provided. In case (b) the connection uses TLS but does not verify the server certificate, leaving the channel vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks against the z/VM Cloud Connector. The warning at line 44 covers the inverse case (non-https URL with ca_file) but no warning is emitted for the riskier case of https without ca_file.
